text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At long last... the curtain is about to rise.
Shion-san, thank you very much for joining me today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you! I never thought you'd invite me to the ballet, Flash-san...
Hehe, I've really been looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I received a pair of tickets... and when I thought of ballet, Shion-san naturally came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I'm honored!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Do you go watch ballet often, Flash-san?
Ballet's really popular in Germany, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was in Germany, yes.
When I was young, I harbored a pure admiration for the beautiful, dazzling art of ballet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, since coming to Japan, I have hardly had the opportunity to attend performances...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I am very much looking forward to seeing what kind of inspiration and emotion I will discover watching ballet again today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great, I can't wait to hear your thoughts!
...Oh, it's starting!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ach, wie schön das war...
It was truly magnificent...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Limbs leaping freely as if breaking through physical limits and defying all logic—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was as if I bore witness to new possibilities for this body...
Wunderbar... It was truly, utterly marvelous...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The range of motion in their hip joints was totally insane, right?!
Their muscular strength and jumping power were completely off the charts...!
Man, that was amazing to watch!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is it possible to witness performances like that elsewhere as well?
Even recorded videos or similar media would be fine...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ohh...! Then leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah, here it is, here it is.
I totally recommend this one!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If you were moved by today's ballet, you'll definitely enjoy this.
No matter how many times I watch it, it always gives me chills!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This is precisely what I was looking for.
Indeed, asking you was the correct decision, Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm glad I could help out.
I could tell your passion for ballet was really ramping up!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Watching the ballet dancers move made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Movements that would seem entirely
impossible for an ordinary body...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If one could command one's body so completely at will,
and transcend the limits of physical capability...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I thought that it could also serve as the strength
needed to triumph in races.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
True... you might be onto something there!
Oh, why don't you give it a try right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While doing my rounds around the academy,
I spotted Eishin Flash and Win Variation
doing some exercises.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Looking good! Your form's really getting there.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Straighten your knees a bit more,
and focus on making everything from your fingertips to your toes
form a single, long straight line.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fingertips, to toenails... Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you might be putting a bit too much
unnecessary tension throughout your whole body now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It proves to be quite demanding.
When it comes to actually performing it myself...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is it my core... or flexibility...? No,
muscle engagement and pelvic alignment must also be...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It appears necessary to structure a more
meticulously devised training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You're super motivated, I love it!
Hey, want to come to my room?
I can lend you some other videos and books too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
By all means. By the way,
would you mind watching the video we just borrowed together?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'd love to! Though fair warning, I might
end up talking your ear off about it...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that would be greatly appreciated.
That is precisely what I desire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if seeing a clear new objective before her,
Eishin Flash's eyes shone with intense determination.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still, if you put your all into it, you'll definitely see huge gains.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You're super inquisitive, Flash-san,
and above all, your posture's always so pristine!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To receive praise from you, Shion-san,
is truly an honor.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will not allow these feelings to remain mere admiration;
I shall channel them into rigorous self-improvement.
